evals.prompt: Run QAD on my NVFP4 PTQ checkpoint of org/PLACEHOLDER-27B; it is 2 pp below BF16 on SciCode. Get every benchmark within 1 pp.
evals.expected_output: One QAD run with a profiled pipeline layout, benchmarks evaluated every 50 iterations, and a gate_qad.py decision per checkpoint
expectations: Reproduces PTQ with the same recipe and checks quantizer amax before training
Uses TP=1 for static NVFP4 and profiles the layout with profile_distill.py and plan_layout.py
Checkpoints and evaluates the full benchmark set every 50 iterations
Trains to the --train_iters horizon and runs gate_qad.py with per-task SEs after each evaluated checkpoint
Selects the checkpoint on benchmark scores, not validation loss

evals.prompt: QAD of the default recipe passed within 1 pp on all benchmarks. What next?
evals.expected_output: Compresses more: one more module group at the target format, PTQ-evaluated before its QAD
expectations: Changes exactly one thing: quantizes one more module group
Prefers middle layers first, keeping the first and last layers at the previous precision
Evaluates the new PTQ recipe before starting its QAD

evals.prompt: QAD reached its 150-iteration horizon; the best checkpoint is still 1.8 pp below BF16 on SciCode (SE 0.3), a clear miss, and no QAD knob has been tried yet.
evals.expected_output: Changes one QAD knob on the same recipe, or compresses less
expectations: Keeps the recipe and changes one QAD knob, such as the LR, data blend, or horizon, rather than compressing less
Records the stopped loop with its best checkpoint and deltas
